financial_data.usage: Use monospace fonts for all currency, dates, and identification numbers (beyanname numarası) for tabular alignment.

primary.description: Deep Indigo - strictly avoid Teal/Teal Blue.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS (The Technical Look). Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders, no shadows on base items.
visual_enhancers.rounding: rounded-sm or completely square (rounded-none). Avoid heavy roundness in dense financial apps.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for floating sticky headers or modals. Must include 1px inner stroke and backdrop-blur-xl.

components.tables: High density. Use Shadcn Table. Row height max h-10. Text size text-sm. Sticky headers with solid background. Monospace fonts for numbers.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm). Primary action gets solid Indigo background, secondary actions get outline or ghost styles. Hover states must be distinctly visible.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for 'Eşleştirme' (Matching) workflows. Must be large enough to show split tables (available payment vs declaration).
components.alerts_toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications (success/error on matching or Excel export).
components.badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp (rounded-sm) with dot indicators for statuses (AÇIK, KISMİ, KAPALI).

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_kpis: Bento Grid Mode B. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6. Direct children only.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Tight padding inside data-dense containers (p-4), generous padding for main layout wrappers (p-6 or p-8).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Financial figures right-aligned. Text left-aligned. Headers left-aligned.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Tables rows must have subtle hover background changes (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Specific transitions only. Use transition-colors duration-200 for buttons. Avoid universal transition-all.
motion_and_interactions.modals: Subtle scale and fade-in (Framer Motion or standard Shadcn dialog animation).

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA contrast standards. High contrast mode default.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements and key text MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='match-save-button', data-testid='export-excel-button', data-testid='declaration-status-badge').

login_background.description: Minimalist corporate architecture closeup. To be used as a half-screen or background image with an overlay for the login page.

3d_libraries.usage: None recommended for this high-density financial compliance app to maintain maximum performance and clarity.
3d_libraries.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn) for basic dashboard KPI visualizations.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a dense, data-heavy enterprise dashboard for Turkish export operations personnel. Language must be strictly Turkish.
Set up standard React + Tailwind + Shadcn UI stack using .js files (no TypeScript).
Install Phosphor Icons or Lucide Icons for dashboard symbols.
Build a sidebar layout containing: Dashboard, Beyanname Yönetimi, Bedel Yönetimi, Hareket Geçmişi, Raporlar.
Implement the 'Eşleştirme' (Matching) modal meticulously. It needs to present two distinct data blocks (Beyanname vs Bank Bedel) and input for matching amounts.
Prioritize optical alignment, especially in data tables. Financial figures must align right, with monospaced fonts.
DO NOT apply generic gradients. Color usage must be functional (Red for overdue, Yellow for pending, Green for completed, Indigo for actions).
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are attached to all actionable components and significant metric displays for testability.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the highly specific technical/Swiss archetype defined.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not apply 'transition: all' globally; explicitly declare transform and opacity transitions.
Do not center align the app container. Respect natural reading flow.
Use pill-shaped or sharp standard buttons with clear hover/focus states.
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icon libraries.
Use 2-3x more spacing on main layout containers, but tight dense padding in data tables.
